input_contract.note: Proposed first integration envelope; endpoint remains unavailable.

implemented_slice: Complete learned 8x subsampler and 24 whole-context Conformer layers on the shared-profile ISA; device-only residual QACT and one weight slot; offline waveform oracle

blockers.detail: Device PCM conversion, preemphasis, STFT, mel, log and masked normalization are missing.
The complete learned 8x subsampler is shared-profile ISA-qualified; its device waveform-frontend and physical runtime handoff are not integrated.
All 24 whole-context Conformer layers and one-slot residency are shared-profile ISA-qualified with real checkpoint weights; physical program/wait loading and execution remain unverified.
Resident two-layer LSTM, token embedding and state commit on non-blank are missing.
Device joint head, separate token/duration selection, blank/zero-duration control and termination are missing.
Device token-to-text output and timestamp conventions are not implemented or qualified.

Learned subsampler plus 24 layers pass real-speech CPU/ISA comparisons with two-pass device QACT; device frontend parity, larger-context numerical coverage and transcript/WER acceptance remain missing.
No real audio-to-transcript FPGA run; a coordinated hardware window is required.
